title: Pianists he has enjoyed working with
summary: Garland names Lil Hardin, Alton Purnell and others, and says many players claim to have played with Ed Garland.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: So you've worked with some of the greatest pianists, I was just thinking of Hines. And Jelly Roll, you know, --
What other pianists did you enjoy working with?
I don't know if you heard of him, Henry -- ah, Henry's name? Wonderful piano player when I was on KFI.
How about the pianists you're working with now, Alton Parker, Alvin Pernell.
All right, me and him work pretty good together.
Fine pianists; anybody in Chicago you enjoyed working with? Particularly, that you remember?

Well -- there's so many - you know you get to playing with so many of them different guys, and they like to play with you -- more than anything else, they like to play with me. In fact right now a lot of these fellows that want to play, have the -- have it said, that they play with Ed Garland. They played with Ed Garland, you know?
